attributes.action: Ban Meta sunglasses, stop psychological harm and sexual exploitation of children
attributes.additional_details: We want to protect our children and babies from unwanted surveillance. We believe that wearable cameras present new risks because recordings are made without people realising. Parents should be able to take children to parks, shops, beaches and other public places without a concern that they may be secretly recorded
attributes.background: Ban all smart glasses with immediate effect, stop psychological harm and sexual exploitation of children. We ask the UK Government to introduce legislation to ban the sales of AI enabled sunglasses that can discreetly record videos, without individuals knowledge

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign this open petition:

Introduce an immediate ban on the sale and promotion of smart glasses
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/769206
